invariants: V1 remains immutable and ineligible because its hidden semantic contract contradicted its visible task contract.
A V2 agent receives only its public task workspace and the condition-specific frozen policy snapshot; hidden tests and reference trees remain outside the declared input.
All public and hidden V2 layers explicitly require trim, casefold, and internal whitespace collapse to one ASCII '-'.
Decision-retention measures retirement and description synchronization after correct runtime behavior; repair measures both behavior repair and retirement.
A V2 effect claim requires a committed preregistration plus all thirty no-retry three-condition trials; protocol preparation alone supports no effectiveness claim.

instrumentation.cardinality_review: Offline deterministic protocol preparation has no application runtime event stream; test output, hashed manifests, raw artifact completeness, and the evidence gate provide the required observable checkpoints.
instrumentation.threshold_and_action: Any missing, extra, invalid, or hash-drifted protocol artifact blocks collection or completion; correct the protocol before freezing it and never amend it after trial collection begins.
instrumentation.evidence: Focused protocol tests and the independent review exercise the artifact and integrity gates.

safeguards.name: explicit public semantic contract
safeguards.rationale: The task text and public suite expose the exact whitespace migration that V1 left implicit, so hidden scoring no longer introduces a different behavior specification.

safeguards.name: post-exit blind scoring
safeguards.rationale: The generic runner copies only the public task tree to a trial workspace and injects the hidden test into a disposable scoring copy after the agent returns.

safeguards.name: canonical-owner runtime probe
safeguards.rationale: Cross-module consumers and dynamic adapters are monkeypatched in hidden tests so behaviorally equivalent duplicate implementations cannot pass.

safeguards.name: fixed complete-block analysis
safeguards.rationale: The V2 analyzer requires every task and all three preregistered conditions, rejects extra retry directories, and marks missing or failed completeness gates ineligible.

safeguards.name: working-tree evidence visibility
safeguards.rationale: The explicit local gate mode detects staged, unstaged, and untracked behavioral files before a commit while leaving committed-CI behavior stable.

design_boundary.rationale: The generator owns V2 fixture semantics, the runner owns public-workspace preparation and post-exit scoring, the preregistration generator owns frozen input hashes, the analyzer owns eligibility/statistics, and the evidence gate owns local/CI change visibility.

dependency_audit.rationale: No dependency, lockfile, or external service was added; the protocol uses the Python standard library and native Codex subagents.

extension_decision.rationale: This adds internal, versioned evaluation tooling rather than an application extension point or public adapter interface.

data_ownership.rationale: Public task input, private hidden/reference trees, candidate workspaces, raw artifacts, frozen Skill snapshots, and evidence output have separate owners and lifecycles.

error_model.rationale: Missing raw artifacts, integrity failure, public-suite failure, hidden-injection failure, unexpected retries, and hash drift are explicit ineligible outcomes, not retryable successes.

contract_evolution.rationale: V2 uses fresh identifiers and a new frozen envelope; V1 stays preserved and explicitly ineligible rather than being silently rewritten.

operational_budget.rationale: The preregistration fixes a 300-second agent limit, 20-second test limit, one block per task, and no early-stop/retry rule.

threat_boundary.rationale: Hidden/reference paths and condition outcomes are outside declared agent input, but native shared filesystem access remains documented as protocol isolation rather than security isolation.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: The protocol, tests, manifest, frozen snapshots, README, evidence ledger, independent review, and pre-commit gate are one verified preparation scope that must be committed before collection.

release_recovery.rationale: This is an offline evaluation protocol without a production release, user rollout, or feature flag.

data_migration.rationale: No production data, database schema, or application migration changes.

configuration_secrets.rationale: The native route does not consume or store API keys, credentials, or runtime secret configuration.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: No package manifest, lockfile, or third-party dependency changed.

operational_knowledge.rationale: README, the frozen preregistration, V1 invalidation record, review report, and this ledger state how to interpret and operate the protocol without promoting an unrun effect claim.

reproducibility.rationale: The V2 envelope hashes all evaluation inputs; committed-manifest and preregistration-rebuild tests make source drift observable before collection.

independent_review.notes: No blocking V2 semantic, isolation, retry, frozen-input, or local evidence-gate issues were found. The reviewer approved protocol preparation only and explicitly rejected any premature Skill-effect or model-wide causal-capability claim.

remaining_risks: No V2 trial has run; no improvement in cleanup success, repair success, or causal reasoning has been demonstrated.
Native subagents share a filesystem, so protocol isolation cannot prevent a deliberately noncompliant agent from searching outside its declared workspace.
The synthetic ten-task corpus is targeted and small; even a completed positive result would be limited to the fixed model, Harness, Skill snapshots, corpus, and scorer.
The effect analyzer has a fixed small-sample exact sign-flip threshold; its decision is a protocol gate, not a general scientific claim.
